article.title: 工具補讀：Google將Computer Use列為正式提供，執行環境仍由開發者搭建
article.title_en: Tool review: Google makes Computer Use generally available
article.summary: Google在10月30日更新中，將Computer Use列為兩款API的正式功能。
article.summary_en: Google’s October 30 release notes mark Computer Use generally available across two APIs.
highlights: 模型讀取螢幕截圖，再提出點擊及鍵盤操作。
應用程式需自行執行動作及處理安全確認。
highlights_en: The model reads screenshots and proposes interface actions.
Applications must execute actions and handle safety decisions.
article.why: 希望自動處理網站工作的團隊，需要把動作執行與審批一併納入設計。
article.why_en: Teams automating web tasks must design execution and approval together.
article.next_step: 先以測試環境評估表格輸入，記錄錯誤與需要確認的操作。
article.next_step_en: Evaluate form entry in a test environment and log errors and confirmations.
article.detail: Computer Use讓模型根據螢幕截圖提出介面操作，開發者仍須建立接收動作、執行操作及回傳新截圖的循環。Google把它列為Interactions及GenerateContent API的正式功能。官方文件亦提醒功能可能出錯，應用程式需處理安全確認或封鎖決定。正式提供不等於可以無人監督執行所有工作，亦不代表所有模型支援相同能力。
article.detail_en: Developers provide the execution loop: receive proposed actions, perform them and return screenshots. Google lists availability across the Interactions and GenerateContent APIs. Its documentation warns of errors and requires applications to handle confirmation or blocked actions. Supported capabilities vary by model.
article.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
